dates.name: Park Silly Sunday Market — Free Local Artisan Marketplace
dates.desc: Explore Downtown Park City's vibrant open-air market featuring 100+ local artisans, handmade jewelry, paintings, sculptures, and fresh produce. Free live music throughout the day, eco-friendly vendor community. Perfect Sunday morning/afternoon date exploring Utah's creative culture.
dates.where: Historic Main Street, Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Grace Potter — Live Concert at Red Butte Garden
dates.desc: Indie rock icon Grace Potter performs an energetic, emotional live show at the beautiful Red Butte Garden outdoor amphitheater. Stunning garden setting with mountain views. Perfect summer concert date under the stars.
dates.where: Red Butte Garden & Arboretum — 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: Greensky Bluegrass — High-Energy Bluegrass at Red Butte
dates.desc: Award-winning bluegrass band known for improvisational energy and skillful musicianship. Beautiful outdoor setting at Red Butte Garden. Great date for music lovers who appreciate live instrumental artistry.
dates.where: Red Butte Garden & Arboretum — 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: Utah Arts Festival — Opening Day & Evening
dates.price: Thursday evening $18 / Friday-Sunday $22 / 4-Day Pack $70 / VIP $85 / Kids 12 & under free
dates.desc: Celebrate 50 years of Utah's premier arts festival! Over 800 artists, 200+ live performances, 80+ films, 25+ food vendors. Visual art galleries, theater, music, dance, film screenings, and cultural performances. One of the largest arts celebrations in the West.
dates.where: Library Square — 210 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Park Silly Sunday Market — Second Visit
dates.desc: Return to Park City's beloved artisan market. Discover new vendors, enjoy live music, browse handmade crafts. Building familiarity with local creators and supporting Utah's maker community. Great Sunday tradition date.
dates.where: Historic Main Street, Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Ziggy Marley — Brightside Tour at Red Butte Garden
dates.desc: Reggae legend Ziggy Marley performs his positive, feel-good music at Red Butte Garden. High-energy performance with beautiful garden setting. Perfect for an uplifting, fun summer concert date.
dates.where: Red Butte Garden & Arboretum — 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: Savor the Summit — Park City's Outdoor Dining Extravaganza
dates.desc: Exclusive outdoor dining event on Historic Main Street! Long communal tables feature curated multi-course menus from Park City's top restaurants. Craft cocktails, wine pairings, live music, and High West Spirit Garden. Romantic, unique, unforgettable Park City experience.
dates.where: Historic Main Street, Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: John Craigie + Blind Pilot — Summer Concert at Red Butte
dates.desc: Indie folk singer-songwriter John Craigie and the introspective Blind Pilot band perform an intimate, heartfelt concert. Beautiful voices, thoughtful lyrics, acoustic arrangements. Perfect for music lovers who appreciate artistic depth.
dates.where: Red Butte Garden & Arboretum — 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: Donut Falls Waterfall Hike — Easy Trail to Unique Cascade
dates.desc: Moderately easy 2-mile hike through Big Cottonwood Canyon to Utah's most unique waterfall—water cascades through a donut-shaped rock and into a cave. June snowmelt makes waterfalls spectacular. Arrive by 8 AM on weekends. Perfect for outdoor exploration you love.
dates.where: Big Cottonwood Canyon — Salt Lake City (20 min east from SLC)

dates.name: Stewart Falls Trail — Waterfall & Alpine Views
dates.desc: Beautiful 3-mile round-trip hike to stunning multi-tiered waterfall near Sundance. Sound of snowmelt crashing through granite gorges. Alpine meadows, wildflowers in June. Combine with lunch at nearby Sundance resort.
dates.where: Stewart Canyon near Sundance — 45 min south from SLC

dates.name: Rockport Reservoir — Scenic Alpine Lake Adventure
dates.desc: Crystal-clear alpine waters nestled in the Uinta Mountains. Perfect for kayaking, paddleboarding, or shoreline picnicking. June weather is ideal. Multiple scenic viewpoints, peaceful fishing areas. Your favorite type of date!
dates.where: Rockport State Park — Coalville, UT (1 hr north from SLC)

dates.name: Antelope Island State Park — Bison Loop & Sunset Drive
dates.desc: Drive the stunning 7-mile scenic loop spotting native bison herds, pronghorn, bighorn sheep. Great Salt Lake backdrop with incredible sunset views. June wildflowers and wildlife at peak. Your type of exploration date.
dates.where: Antelope Island State Park — 4528 W 1700 S, Syracuse, UT 84075

dates.name: Horseback Riding at Sundance — Alpine Trail Adventures
dates.desc: Guided horseback rides through scenic Sundance mountain trails. Multiple options: Elk Meadows (easy), Stewart Falls (moderate with waterfall views), or yoga + horseback combo. June wildflowers in full bloom. Peaceful, romantic mountain experience.
dates.where: Sundance Resort — 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604 (45 min south)

dates.name: Dinner at Handle — Park City Chef-Driven Dining
dates.desc: Intimate restaurant with Dave Jones' celebrated seasonal small plates. Fresh fish, heritage meats, creative vegetables. Excellent wine list, sophisticated yet approachable. Cozy, romantic atmosphere. Perfect for special dates.
dates.where: Handle — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at Log Haven — Millcreek Canyon Fine Dining
dates.desc: Scenic mountain setting four miles up Millcreek Canyon. Chef Dave Jones' Southwestern-influenced menu, beautiful views, excellent service. Romantic and just minutes from downtown.
dates.where: Log Haven — Millcreek Canyon, Salt Lake City, UT

dates.name: Dinner at Riverhorse on Main — Park City Contemporary
dates.desc: Modern American cuisine in the heart of Park City with elegant seasonal menus. Fresh local ingredients, sophisticated presentation, excellent wine program. Historic building on Main Street. Participating in Savor the Summit (June 27)!
dates.where: Riverhorse on Main — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Just Add Chocolate Workshop — Lehi Chocolate Crafting
dates.desc: Become a real chocolatier! Create your own delicious, rich chocolate confections in a hands-on workshop, then take home your creations. Fun, unique date activity perfect for couples who love something different.
dates.where: Just Add Chocolate — 1873 W Traverse Pkwy D, Lehi, UT

dates.name: Downtown Farmers Market — Fresh Produce & Local Vibes
dates.desc: Browse fresh local produce, artisan goods, and local vendors every Saturday through October. Grab breakfast or lunch from food carts. Beautiful outdoor setting with community energy. Perfect casual date exploring local food scene.
dates.where: Pioneer Park — Downtown Salt Lake City (Saturdays June-Oct)

dates.name: Broadway Theater Productions — Eccles Theater
dates.desc: World-class theatrical performances. You gave Phantom of the Opera a perfect 5 stars! Check the Eccles schedule for similar high-caliber musicals and plays. Stunning productions, exceptional talent, unforgettable evenings.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Utah Arts Festival — Visual Galleries & Artist Booths
dates.desc: Browse 800+ visual artists and craftspeople displaying paintings, sculptures, jewelry, photography, and mixed media. Artist demonstrations, interactive workshops. June 18-21 (Thurs-Sun). Celebrate Utah's creative culture.
dates.where: Library Square — 210 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Natural History Museum of Utah — Paleontology & Discovery
dates.desc: World-class museum with 60,000+ fossils, interactive exhibits, stunning valley views. Educational, fascinating, perfect for exploration and learning together. June is ideal weather for visiting.
dates.where: Natural History Museum of Utah — 301 S 1300 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84112

dates.name: Red Butte Garden — Summer Botanical & Concert Venue
dates.desc: Utah's premier botanical garden with summer blooms, peaceful pathways, stunning valley views. Perfect for daytime stroll. Also host to incredible summer concert series (Grace Potter, Ziggy Marley, John Craigie in June).
dates.where: Red Butte Garden — 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108
dates.reservation: none for daytime / recommended for concerts

dates.name: First Friday Gallery Walk — Downtown Arts District
dates.desc: Explore vibrant downtown arts district on the first Friday of each month (June 6). Local artists, contemporary installations, rotating exhibits. Grab dinner, discuss art together, discover new favorites in lively evening atmosphere.
dates.where: Salt Lake City Arts District — Downtown SLC

dates.name: Scenic Biking — Park City Mountain Bike Trails
dates.desc: Scenic mountain biking through Park City with trails for all levels. June weather is perfect—cool mornings, beautiful alpine views. From easy family-friendly paths to challenging single-track. Great active date.
dates.where: Park City Mountain Resort — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: TopGolf Vineyard — Gamified Golf & Friendly Competition
dates.desc: Private bay with automatic scoring, full bar, great food. Zero golf skill required—just fun, friendly competition, and laughter. Relaxed, upbeat date night energy perfect for couples.
dates.where: TopGolf — 484 N Entertainment Way, Vineyard, UT (20 min from SLC)

dates.name: Escape Room Challenge — Puzzle & Teamwork
dates.desc: 60-minute immersive puzzle experience with themed rooms. Solve puzzles together, race the clock, enjoy the teamwork and challenge. Great for competitive couples who love brain teasers.
dates.where: Getout Games — 202 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Kayaking or SUP — Bear Lake Turquoise Waters
dates.desc: Pristine alpine lake with stunning turquoise water. Peaceful paddling perfect for couples. June weather warms the lake. Multiple access points, beautiful mountain scenery, sunset paddling opportunities.
dates.where: Bear Lake State Park — Garden City, UT (1.5 hrs north)

dates.name: Alpine Hiking — Wasatch Mountain Trail Adventures
dates.desc: Diverse hiking options in the Wasatch Mountains accessible from Salt Lake. From Bells Canyon waterfall hike (2 hrs) to Mirror Lake scenic hike (3-4 hrs). June high-altitude snow remains on some slopes—check conditions. Perfect for outdoor-loving couples.
dates.where: Various Wasatch canyons and trails (20-45 min from SLC)

dates.name: Park City Historic Main Street — Shopping & Exploration
dates.desc: Charming downtown with unique shops, galleries, restaurants, breweries. Explore historic architecture, local boutiques. Perfect casual date for wandering, discovering unique finds, and grabbing lunch or drinks.
dates.where: Historic Main Street, Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Utah Arts Festival — Independent Film Screenings
dates.desc: Browse 80+ independent films from around the world at Utah Arts Festival (June 18-21). Discover documentaries, short films, international cinema. Film lovers will appreciate the curation.
dates.where: Library Square — 210 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Outlets at Traverse Mountain — Lehi Shopping Experience
dates.desc: Utah's only outlet mall with major brands and deals. Mix shopping with lunch at local restaurants or visit nearby Just Add Chocolate for a chocolate-making workshop. Fun combined activity.
dates.where: Outlets at Traverse Mountain — Lehi, UT (20 min from SLC, exit 284)

dates.name: Outdoor Summer Concert Series — Free Live Music Picnic
dates.desc: Free outdoor concerts at Red Butte Garden, parks throughout SLC and Park City all summer. Bring a picnic blanket and enjoy live music under June stars. Budget-friendly romance with incredible musical lineups.
dates.where: Various parks and Red Butte Garden throughout SLC and Park City

dates.name: Comedy Night — Live Stand-Up Comedy
dates.desc: Live stand-up comedy at local venues. Great laughs, casual atmosphere, fun evening of entertainment. Perfect for low-pressure fun, connection, and shared laughter.
dates.where: The Wiseguys Comedy Club & other venues — Downtown SLC
